definitions.explanation: Indulging in pleasant but unrealistic thoughts or imaginings. Often implies that the thoughts are detached from reality or unlikely to be realized.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{夢想|むそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}め→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧{夢想|むそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ふけって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He was lost in reverie, gazing out the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧{夢想|むそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{理想|りそう}→理想：03676_risou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Some say world peace is nothing but a fantasy, but it is important to have ideals.

notes:
A compound of {夢|む} (dream) and {想|そう} (thought, imagination). The verb form is {夢想|むそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Has a literary tone and often carries a nuance of unrealistic thinking, though it can also be used more neutrally for imaginative contemplation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夢想|むそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふける→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧: to be lost in daydreams
- {夢想|むそう}{家|か}: a dreamer, a visionary
- {夢想|むそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない: to be nothing but a fantasy
- {夢想|むそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to daydream, to fantasize

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{空想|くうそう}→空想：00256_kuusou⟧: fantasy, daydream — very similar but slightly more neutral; also used in ⟦{空想|くうそう}{科学|かがく}→空想科学：26119_kuusoukagaku⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ (science fiction)
- ⟦{妄想|もうそう}→妄想：06813_mousou⟧: delusion, paranoid fantasy — stronger negative nuance, implies irrational or obsessive thinking
- ⟦{幻想|げんそう}→幻想：06753_gensou⟧: illusion, fantasy — emphasizes something illusory or enchanting
